comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null and empty-list rules. The constructs differ in scope. Left requires a specific, verifiable procedural example, meaning a concrete description of an actual process, rule, protocol or practice. Right accepts any specific empirical evidence, such as data, statistics, studies or documented cases. Right is broader: statistics or study findings that are not procedural would count there but not on the left. Left is a narrower subtype, and it also explicitly ignores quoted OP text.
